title: Characterization of Word-Representable Planar Graphs
exact_target: Describe exactly which finite planar graphs can be encoded by a word whose alternating pairs are precisely their edges.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1431 (GRAPH-044). CC BY 4.0.

Suchanda Roy and Ramesh Hariharasubramanian, Characterization of Word-Representable Near-Triangulations, arXiv:2605.25733v1 (2026), Sections 1--2, near-triangulation definition and word-representability.

Magnus M. Halldórsson, Sergey Kitaev and Artem Pyatkin, Semi-Transitive Orientations and Word-Representable Graphs, arXiv:1501.07108v1 (2015), Section 1, definitions and general orientation characterization.
